company_evidence.reported_dateline: ASTANA, 26 May 2011; the page states that the information is from the KBM press service.
company_evidence.attribution_scope: KBM company/management position only. Salary figures and wage-action claims are explicitly statements about KBM; do not attribute them to ATS/TMS or to all employers.
coder_visible_source_summary: The archived page explicitly attributes the information to the KBM press service.
The company rejects the strikers' pay-coefficient demands as unfounded and cites official/legal opinions supporting that position.
The company describes its own recurring wage/tariff increases and states that over 2007–2011 employee wages increased within a 59.5%–90.1% range.
The company gives current minimum and maximum tariff figures, including a minimum monthly-equivalent tariff of 70,038 tenge and a maximum tariff of 181,822 tenge before additional payments.
The page reports that KBM management had repeatedly proposed resolving the dispute at the negotiating table.
These are company-declared positions/actions, not independent proof that compensation was fair or that the workers accepted the claims.
limited_verbatim_evidence: КБМ произведено повышение заработных плат работников в диапазоне от 59,5% до 90,1 % от размера заработной платы
